vision.name: Namekian Assimilation
vision.text:
(If this card is discarded from your hand by a Mastery effect, stops a physical or energy attack in your opponent's next action this combat.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when an opponent's Setup, Drill, Ally, or attached card enters play. You may shuffle a Dragon Ball you own in play into your Life Deck to banish a Setup, Drill, Ally, or attached card.
(Banish after use.)
(Created by Miguel Gonzalez, OP2 West Kai Champion)
